question: What functional designation is given to these yantras when they are named?
premises: etāni yantrāṇi names the devices under discussion
inference: These yantras are, by name, designated as all-work-doing devices.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic agreement of sarvakāryakṛt with the plural yantrāṇi is not fully resolved by the five-token line alone.
plain_english: Thus these yantras are, by name, all-work-doing.
